# Gus

[Conservative](../codex/factions.md#conservative)

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P30](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P32](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0032)</sub>

## Appearance

Gus is described as a midget of a man. In comparison to others, he possesses a notably small physical frame.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P32](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0032)_

## Personality

Gus is an individual who exhibits a notably mild demeanor. Despite this gentle disposition, he is capable of demonstrating surprisingly bloodthirsty tendencies.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P32](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0032)_

## History

Gus is mentioned during a discussion between Miss Cornelia and Captain Jim regarding their political opinions surrounding a federal election. He is celebrated or lamented alongside other political figures depending on the party victories. Ultimately, his involvement is highlighted as part of the broader political commentary shared among the neighbors.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P1](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P2](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P3](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P4](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P5](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P7](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0007), +23 more_
